note: One parameter feeds two modifier inputs; its range is the intersection of the inputs it feeds.

markup: <StackPanel><StackPanel.Resources><TimbreClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/outer.wav";</TimbreClip></StackPanel.Resources><Border><Border.Resources><TimbreClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/inner.wav"; @parameter Cut: float = 900; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; }</TimbreClip></Border.Resources><Button Content="Inner"><Button.Aspect>@on Click { @timbre $Tone(Cut = 400); }</Button.Aspect></Button></Border></StackPanel>

<Border><Border.Resources><TimbreClip Name="ErrorTimbre">Source = "audio/error.wav";</TimbreClip></Border.Resources><Border.Aspect>@handle Playback; @when $self.IsEnabled { @if value == true { @timbre $ErrorTimbre as Playback; } @if value == false { @cancel Playback; } }</Border.Aspect></Border>

<Button Content="Music"><Button.Resources><TimbreClip Name="BackgroundMusic">Source = "audio/music.ogg";</TimbreClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@handle Music; @on Loaded { @timbre $BackgroundMusic(Loop = true) as Music; } @on Click { @pause Music; } @on MouseEnter { @resume Music; } @on MouseLeave { @seek Music to 30s; }</Button.Aspect></Button>

note: @timbre starts in source order before the single visual Motion root; it is not a Motion execution child.
markup: <Button Content="Mixed"><Button.Resources><TimbreClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</TimbreClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@on Click { @timbre $Tone; @animate with Tween(200ms, EaseOut) { @to { Opacity = 0.5; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

<StackPanel><StackPanel.Resources><TimbreClip Name="Tone">Source = "audio/tone.wav";</TimbreClip><Aspect Name="Clicky" TargetType="Button">@on Click { @timbre $Tone; }</Aspect></StackPanel.Resources><Button Content="A" Aspect="$Clicky" /><Button Content="B" Aspect="$Clicky" /></StackPanel>
